chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of opposition on wise counsel according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) illustrates how persistent opposition or conflicting viewpoints can erode the clarity and authority of sound judgment (ra'y). This teaching underscores the psychological and social dynamics of leadership, where dissent, if not managed, can destabilize even the most prudent counsel. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the interplay between intellectual conviction and communal reception in governance.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 215. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
